summaries.n-stock-paired-coins: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. RETARD (Retardatide, StonkFun) says "Paired to LLY. You get paid LLY stock just for holding retardatide", and CHAD (CHAD, LaunchLab) says "Backed by tokenized HIMS stock" (both d2:0, the coins' own descriptions). The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
